notes: This dataset contains information about the fish assemblages on Gran Canaria with the following columns: Tide pool (Survey site), Type (Artificial or Natural), Month of the Survey, Date of the Survey, Fish Family, Fish Species, Abundance of Side A of the Tide Pool, Abundance of Side B of the Tide Pool, Total Abundance of both Sides, Users that were present at the Tide Pool at the time of the Survey.
